items.question: Trong câu "Many interview problems ask you to build an answer from a sequence of choices: which items go in the subset, where the next queen goes, which meeting to book next.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many interview problems ask you to build an answer from a sequence of choices: which items go in the subset, where the next queen goes, which meeting to book next.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (danh từ): chuỗi, dãy nối tiếp. "A sequence of choices" = một chuỗi các lựa chọn nối tiếp nhau.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (noun): an ordered series of things. "A sequence of choices" means a series of decisions made one after another.

items.question: Trong câu "There are two opposite strategies:", từ "opposite" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are two opposite strategies:", what does "opposite" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ (tính từ): trái ngược nhau. Hai chiến lược "opposite" đi theo hướng ngược nhau: thử tất cả vs chỉ chọn một.
items.explanationEn: opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ (adjective): completely different, contrary. Two opposite strategies go in contrary directions: try everything vs pick just one.

items.question: Trong câu "but abandon a partial answer the moment it cannot lead to a valid solution.", từ "abandon" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "but abandon a partial answer the moment it cannot lead to a valid solution.", what does "abandon" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give up on, stop pursuing
items.explanation: abandon /əˈbændən/ (động từ): từ bỏ, bỏ dở. "Abandon a partial answer" = bỏ dở một lời giải đang xây dở khi thấy nó vô vọng.
items.explanationEn: abandon /əˈbændən/ (verb): to give up on, stop pursuing. "Abandon a partial answer" means dropping a half-built answer once it is hopeless.

items.question: Trong câu "but abandon a partial answer the moment it cannot lead to a valid solution.", từ "partial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "but abandon a partial answer the moment it cannot lead to a valid solution.", what does "partial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: partial /ˈpɑːʃl/ (tính từ): một phần, chưa hoàn chỉnh. "Partial answer" = lời giải mới xây một phần; nghĩa khác "partial to" là thiên vị.
items.explanationEn: partial /ˈpɑːʃl/ (adjective): incomplete, only part of. "Partial answer" is an answer built only in part; "partial to" means having a bias.

items.question: Trong câu "It is exhaustive, so it is always correct, and usually exponential.", từ "exhaustive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is exhaustive, so it is always correct, and usually exponential.", what does "exhaustive" (adjective) mean?
options: vét cạn, xét hết mọi khả năng
items.explanation: exhaustive /ɪɡˈzɔːstɪv/ (tính từ): vét cạn, xét hết mọi khả năng. "Exhaustive search" = tìm kiếm vét cạn; cùng gốc với "exhausting" (mệt lả).
items.explanationEn: exhaustive /ɪɡˈzɔːstɪv/ (adjective): covering every possibility. "Exhaustive search" checks every option; it shares a root with "exhausting" (tiring).

items.question: Trong câu "choice at every step and never reconsider it.", từ "reconsider" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "choice at every step and never reconsider it.", what does "reconsider" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reconsider /ˌriːkənˈsɪdər/ (động từ): xem xét lại. "Never reconsider a choice" = không bao giờ xem xét lại lựa chọn đã đưa ra.
items.explanationEn: reconsider /ˌriːkənˈsɪdər/ (verb): to think about again. "Never reconsider a choice" means never going back to rethink a decision.

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic programming (topic 20) sits in between: it also explores all choices, but reuses the answers to overlapping subproblems.", từ "overlapping" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic programming (topic 20) sits in between: it also explores all choices, but reuses the answers to overlapping subproblems.", what does "overlapping" (adjective) mean?
options: chồng lấn, trùng lặp một phần
items.explanation: overlapping /ˌəʊvəˈlæpɪŋ/ (tính từ): chồng lấn, trùng lặp một phần. "Overlapping subproblems" = các bài toán con lặp lại, là dấu hiệu dùng DP.
items.explanationEn: overlapping /ˌəʊvəˈlæpɪŋ/ (adjective): partly covering the same ground. "Overlapping subproblems" repeat across branches, the classic sign to use DP.

items.question: Trong câu "All three can be pictured as a state-space tree: the root is the empty answer, each edge is a choice, and each leaf is a complete candidate.", từ "candidate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All three can be pictured as a state-space tree: the root is the empty answer, each edge is a choice, and each leaf is a complete candidate.", what does "candidate" (noun) mean?
options: phương án ứng viên cần xét
items.explanation: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (danh từ): phương án ứng viên cần xét. "Candidate solution" = phương án có thể là đáp án, cần kiểm tra.
items.explanationEn: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (noun): an option being considered. A "candidate solution" is a possible answer that still has to be checked.

items.question: Trong câu "Backtracking walks this tree depth-first and cuts off branches that are already invalid.", từ "cut off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backtracking walks this tree depth-first and cuts off branches that are already invalid.", what does "cut off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cut off /kʌt ˈɒf/ (cụm từ): cắt bỏ, loại bỏ. "Cut off a branch" = cắt bỏ nhánh; "cut someone off" còn nghĩa là ngắt lời.
items.explanationEn: cut off /kʌt ˈɒf/ (phrase): to remove, to stop early. "Cut off a branch" means removing it; "cut someone off" can also mean interrupting.

items.question: Trong câu "Backtracking is recursion (topic 5) with one extra habit: undo your choice after the recursive call returns, so the shared state is clean for the next sibling branch.", từ "sibling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backtracking is recursion (topic 5) with one extra habit: undo your choice after the recursive call returns, so the shared state is clean for the next sibling branch.", what does "sibling" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a node at the same level
items.explanation: sibling /ˈsɪblɪŋ/ (danh từ): nút/nhánh cùng cấp. "Sibling branch" = nhánh anh em có cùng nút cha; nghĩa gốc là anh chị em ruột.
items.explanationEn: sibling /ˈsɪblɪŋ/ (noun): a node at the same level. A "sibling branch" shares the same parent; the everyday sense is a brother or sister.

items.question: Trong câu "Backtracking is recursion (topic 5) with one extra habit: undo your choice after the recursive call returns, so the shared state is clean for the next sibling branch.", từ "undo" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backtracking is recursion (topic 5) with one extra habit: undo your choice after the recursive call returns, so the shared state is clean for the next sibling branch.", what does "undo" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: undo /ʌnˈduː/ (động từ): hoàn tác, đảo ngược. "Undo a change" = hoàn tác thay đổi; "undo a button" là cởi nút áo.
items.explanationEn: undo /ʌnˈduː/ (verb): to reverse an action. "Undo a change" reverses it; "undo a button" means unfastening it.

items.question: Trong câu "To design one, answer four questions: what is the state (path plus helpers such as used), what are the choices at this depth, what constraint rejects a choice early, and what goal means the answer is complete.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To design one, answer four questions: what is the state (path plus helpers such as used), what are the choices at this depth, what constraint rejects a choice early, and what goal means the answer is complete.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
options: ràng buộc, điều kiện giới hạn
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, điều kiện giới hạn. "Under constraints" = trong điều kiện có ràng buộc; "constraint satisfaction" là thỏa mãn ràng buộc.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limiting rule or condition. "Under constraints" means within limiting rules; "constraint satisfaction" is meeting them.

items.question: Trong câu "To design one, answer four questions: what is the state (path plus helpers such as used), what are the choices at this depth, what constraint rejects a choice early, and what goal means the answer is complete.", từ "reject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To design one, answer four questions: what is the state (path plus helpers such as used), what are the choices at this depth, what constraint rejects a choice early, and what goal means the answer is complete.", what does "reject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (động từ): loại bỏ, bác bỏ. "Reject a choice early" = loại một lựa chọn sớm; trái nghĩa với "accept".
items.explanationEn: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (verb): to refuse, rule out. "Reject a choice early" means ruling it out early; the opposite of "accept".

items.question: Trong câu "Two classic bugs: pushing path itself instead of a copy (every stored result ends up as the same, finally empty, array), and forgetting the un-choose step (state from one branch leaks into the next).", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two classic bugs: pushing path itself instead of a copy (every stored result ends up as the same, finally empty, array), and forgetting the un-choose step (state from one branch leaks into the next).", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to escape into where it should not be
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): rò rỉ, lọt sang. "State leaks into" = trạng thái bị lọt sang nơi khác; "memory leak" = rò rỉ bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to escape into where it should not be. "State leaks into" another branch means it escapes there; compare "memory leak".

items.question: Trong câu "Two classic bugs: pushing path itself instead of a copy (every stored result ends up as the same, finally empty, array), and forgetting the un-choose step (state from one branch leaks into the next).", từ "end up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two classic bugs: pushing path itself instead of a copy (every stored result ends up as the same, finally empty, array), and forgetting the un-choose step (state from one branch leaks into the next).", what does "end up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: end up /end ˈʌp/ (cụm từ): rốt cuộc trở thành. "End up as X" = cuối cùng thành X (thường ngoài ý muốn).
items.explanationEn: end up /end ˈʌp/ (phrase): to finally become. "End up as X" means to finally become X, often unintentionally.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a start index so each element is only considered after the ones before it.", từ "consider" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a start index so each element is only considered after the ones before it.", what does "consider" (verb) mean?
options: xét đến, đưa vào xem xét
items.explanation: consider /kənˈsɪdər/ (động từ): xét đến, đưa vào xem xét. "Be considered" ở đây = được xét đến; "consider X to be Y" là coi X là Y.
items.explanationEn: consider /kənˈsɪdər/ (verb): to take into account. "Be considered" here means being taken into account; "consider X Y" means regard X as Y.

items.question: Trong câu "That prevents producing both [1, 2] and [2, 1].", từ "prevent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That prevents producing both [1, 2] and [2, 1].", what does "prevent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (động từ): ngăn chặn. "Prevent (someone from) doing something" = ngăn không cho việc gì xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (verb): to stop from happening. "Prevent (someone from) doing something" means stopping it from happening.

items.question: Trong câu "That prevents producing both [1, 2] and [2, 1].", từ "produce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That prevents producing both [1, 2] and [2, 1].", what does "produce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (động từ): tạo ra, sinh ra. "Produce output/duplicates" = sinh ra kết quả/bản trùng.
items.explanationEn: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (verb): to generate, create. "Produce output/duplicates" means generating results or repeated copies.

items.question: Trong câu "Auxiliary space is O(n) for the recursion depth and path, not counting the O(n · 2ⁿ) output.", từ "auxiliary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Auxiliary space is O(n) for the recursion depth and path, not counting the O(n · 2ⁿ) output.", what does "auxiliary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: auxiliary /ɔːɡˈzɪliəri/ (tính từ): phụ trợ, bổ sung. "Auxiliary space" = bộ nhớ phụ ngoài dữ liệu đầu vào/đầu ra.
items.explanationEn: auxiliary /ɔːɡˈzɪliəri/ (adjective): extra, supporting. "Auxiliary space" is the extra memory beyond the input and output.

items.question: Trong câu "Auxiliary space is O(n) for the recursion depth and path, not counting the O(n · 2ⁿ) output.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Auxiliary space is O(n) for the recursion depth and path, not counting the O(n · 2ⁿ) output.", what does "depth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depth /depθ/ (danh từ): độ sâu. "Recursion depth" = số tầng gọi đệ quy lồng nhau; "in depth" = chuyên sâu.
items.explanationEn: depth /depθ/ (noun): how deep something goes. "Recursion depth" is how many nested calls are active; "in depth" means thoroughly.

items.question: Trong câu "Problem: return every ordering of [1, 2, 3].", từ "ordering" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Problem: return every ordering of [1, 2, 3].", what does "ordering" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ordering /ˈɔːdərɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách sắp thứ tự. "Every ordering" = mọi cách sắp thứ tự, tức hoán vị.
items.explanationEn: ordering /ˈɔːdərɪŋ/ (noun): an arrangement in sequence. "Every ordering" means every arrangement, i.e. every permutation.

items.question: Trong câu "Order now matters, so a start index is wrong — every unused element is a candidate at every position.", từ "unused" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Order now matters, so a start index is wrong — every unused element is a candidate at every position.", what does "unused" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unused /ʌnˈjuːzd/ (tính từ): chưa được dùng. "Unused element" = phần tử chưa dùng; "unused to" nghĩa là chưa quen.
items.explanationEn: unused /ʌnˈjuːzd/ (adjective): not yet used. An "unused element" has not been taken yet; "unused to" means not accustomed to.

items.question: Trong câu "Track usage with a boolean array.", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Track usage with a boolean array.", what does "track" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to monitor, keep a record of
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi, ghi nhận. "Track usage" = theo dõi việc dùng; "keep track of" = nắm, ghi nhận.
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to monitor, keep a record of. "Track usage" means recording what is used; "keep track of" is a common variant.

items.question: Trong câu "Track usage with a boolean array.", từ "usage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Track usage with a boolean array.", what does "usage" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the way a word is used
items.explanation: usage /ˈjuːsɪdʒ/ (danh từ): việc sử dụng. "Track usage" = ghi nhận phần tử nào đã được dùng; "word usage" là cách dùng từ.
items.explanationEn: usage /ˈjuːsɪdʒ/ (noun): the act of using. "Track usage" records which items are in use; "word usage" is how words are used.

items.question: Trong câu "The first slot has n options, the second n − 1, and so on, giving n! leaves.", từ "slot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first slot has n options, the second n − 1, and so on, giving n! leaves.", what does "slot" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: slot /slɒt/ (danh từ): ô, vị trí trống. "Slot" = vị trí cần điền; "time slot" = khung giờ, "coin slot" = khe bỏ xu.
items.explanationEn: slot /slɒt/ (noun): a position to be filled. A "slot" is a position to fill; compare "time slot" and "coin slot".

items.question: Trong câu "The first slot has n options, the second n − 1, and so on, giving n! leaves.", từ "and so on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first slot has n options, the second n − 1, and so on, giving n! leaves.", what does "and so on" (phrase) mean?
options: vân vân, cứ thế tiếp tục
optionsEn: and continuing in the same way
items.explanation: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (cụm từ): vân vân, cứ thế tiếp tục. "And so on" = và cứ tiếp tục như vậy, tương đương "etc.".
items.explanationEn: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (phrase): and continuing in the same way. "And so on" means the pattern continues, like "etc.".

items.question: Trong câu "The first slot has n options, the second n − 1, and so on, giving n! leaves.", từ "leaf" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first slot has n options, the second n − 1, and so on, giving n! leaves.", what does "leaf" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: leaf /liːf/ (danh từ): nút lá (không có con). "Leaf" (số nhiều "leaves") = nút lá ở cuối cây, không có nút con.
items.explanationEn: leaf /liːf/ (noun): a node with no children. A "leaf" (plural "leaves") is an end node of a tree with no children.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: order does not matter (subsets, combinations) → start index; order matters (permutations) → used[].", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: order does not matter (subsets, combinations) → start index; order matters (permutations) → used[].", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "As a rule of thumb" = theo kinh nghiệm chung, không phải quy tắc chặt chẽ.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline. "As a rule of thumb" means as a practical guideline, not a strict rule.

items.question: Trong câu "Plain enumeration visits the whole tree.", từ "enumeration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Plain enumeration visits the whole tree.", what does "enumeration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: enumeration /ɪˌnjuːməˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự liệt kê từng cái. "Enumeration" = liệt kê lần lượt; động từ "enumerate".
items.explanationEn: enumeration /ɪˌnjuːməˈreɪʃn/ (noun): listing items one by one. "Enumeration" means listing items one by one; the verb is "enumerate".

items.question: Trong câu "Plain enumeration visits the whole tree.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Plain enumeration visits the whole tree.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): đơn thuần, không thêm gì. "Plain enumeration" = liệt kê đơn thuần, không cắt tỉa; "plain text" = văn bản thô.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): simple, with nothing added. "Plain enumeration" has no pruning added; compare "plain text".

items.question: Trong câu "Pruning means rejecting a branch as soon as it is clearly hopeless, which is what makes backtracking faster than generate-then-filter brute force.", từ "pruning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pruning means rejecting a branch as soon as it is clearly hopeless, which is what makes backtracking faster than generate-then-filter brute force.", what does "pruning" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pruning /ˈpruːnɪŋ/ (danh từ): cắt tỉa (nhánh tìm kiếm). "Pruning" trong thuật toán = bỏ các nhánh vô vọng; nghĩa gốc là tỉa cành cây.
items.explanationEn: pruning /ˈpruːnɪŋ/ (noun): cutting away search branches. In algorithms "pruning" drops hopeless branches; literally it means trimming plants.

items.question: Trong câu "Pruning means rejecting a branch as soon as it is clearly hopeless, which is what makes backtracking faster than generate-then-filter brute force.", từ "hopeless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pruning means rejecting a branch as soon as it is clearly hopeless, which is what makes backtracking faster than generate-then-filter brute force.", what does "hopeless" (adjective) mean?
options: vô vọng, không thể thành công
items.explanation: hopeless /ˈhəʊpləs/ (tính từ): vô vọng, không thể thành công. "A hopeless branch" = nhánh chắc chắn không dẫn tới lời giải.
items.explanationEn: hopeless /ˈhəʊpləs/ (adjective): with no chance of success. A "hopeless branch" cannot possibly lead to a solution.

items.question: Trong câu "Pruning means rejecting a branch as soon as it is clearly hopeless, which is what makes backtracking faster than generate-then-filter brute force.", từ "brute force" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pruning means rejecting a branch as soon as it is clearly hopeless, which is what makes backtracking faster than generate-then-filter brute force.", what does "brute force" (phrase) mean?
options: vét cạn thô, thử mọi thứ
items.explanation: brute force /ˌbruːt ˈfɔːs/ (cụm từ): vét cạn thô, thử mọi thứ. "Brute-force solution" = cách giải thử hết mọi khả năng, không có mẹo.
items.explanationEn: brute force /ˌbruːt ˈfɔːs/ (phrase): trying everything naively. A "brute-force solution" naively tries every possibility with no shortcuts.

items.question: Trong câu "Problem: given distinct positive candidates and a target, list every combination that sums to target; a number may be reused.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Problem: given distinct positive candidates and a target, list every combination that sums to target; a number may be reused.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): khác nhau, không trùng. "Distinct values" = các giá trị không trùng nhau; "a distinct smell" = mùi rõ rệt.
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): different from each other. "Distinct values" contain no repeats; "a distinct smell" means a noticeable one.

items.question: Trong câu "The depth is at most target / min(candidates), and the run time is exponential in that depth.", từ "exponential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The depth is at most target / min(candidates), and the run time is exponential in that depth.", what does "exponential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exponential /ˌekspəˈnenʃl/ (tính từ): tăng theo hàm mũ. "Exponential in n" = tăng theo hàm mũ của n, ví dụ O(2ⁿ).
items.explanationEn: exponential /ˌekspəˈnenʃl/ (adjective): growing like a power. "Exponential in n" means growth like O(2ⁿ).

items.question: Trong câu "Place exactly one queen per row, so rows never clash.", từ "clash" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Place exactly one queen per row, so rows never clash.", what does "clash" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clash /klæʃ/ (động từ): xung đột, va chạm. "Never clash" = không bao giờ xung đột; "schedules clash" = lịch bị trùng.
items.explanationEn: clash /klæʃ/ (verb): to conflict. "Never clash" means never conflict; "schedules clash" when they overlap.

items.question: Trong câu "Problem: place n queens on an n × n board so that no two share a row, column or diagonal.", từ "diagonal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Problem: place n queens on an n × n board so that no two share a row, column or diagonal.", what does "diagonal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: diagonal /daɪˈæɡənl/ (danh từ): đường chéo. "Diagonal" = đường chéo; "anti-diagonal" = đường chéo phụ.
items.explanationEn: diagonal /daɪˈæɡənl/ (noun): a slanted line across. A "diagonal" is a slanted line; the "anti-diagonal" runs the other way.

items.question: Trong câu "The tree has at most n · (n−1) · … nodes, so time is bounded by O(n!) (in practice far less thanks to pruning); auxiliary space is O(n).", từ "bound" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The tree has at most n · (n−1) · … nodes, so time is bounded by O(n!) (in practice far less thanks to pruning); auxiliary space is O(n).", what does "bound" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (động từ): bị chặn trên, giới hạn. "Bounded by O(n!)" = không vượt quá O(n!); "upper bound" = cận trên.
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (verb): to be limited above by. "Bounded by O(n!)" means never exceeding it; compare "upper bound".

items.question: Trong câu "The tree has at most n · (n−1) · … nodes, so time is bounded by O(n!) (in practice far less thanks to pruning); auxiliary space is O(n).", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The tree has at most n · (n−1) · … nodes, so time is bounded by O(n!) (in practice far less thanks to pruning); auxiliary space is O(n).", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. "In practice" = trên thực tế, đối lập với "in theory".
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (phrase): in real situations. "In practice" means in reality, as opposed to "in theory".

items.question: Trong câu "The tree has at most n · (n−1) · … nodes, so time is bounded by O(n!) (in practice far less thanks to pruning); auxiliary space is O(n).", từ "thanks to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The tree has at most n · (n−1) · … nodes, so time is bounded by O(n!) (in practice far less thanks to pruning); auxiliary space is O(n).", what does "thanks to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: thanks to /ˈθæŋks tuː/ (cụm từ): nhờ vào. "Thanks to X" = nhờ X mà có kết quả (thường tích cực).
items.explanationEn: thanks to /ˈθæŋks tuː/ (phrase): because of. "Thanks to X" means because of X, usually a good result.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimate backtracking cost as (number of nodes) × (work per node), where nodes ≈ branching factor raised to the depth.", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimate backtracking cost as (number of nodes) × (work per node), where nodes ≈ branching factor raised to the depth.", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈestɪmeɪt/ (động từ): ước lượng. "Estimate the cost" = ước lượng chi phí; danh từ "estimate" /ˈestɪmət/.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈestɪmeɪt/ (verb): to roughly calculate. "Estimate the cost" means roughly calculating it; the noun is pronounced /ˈestɪmət/.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimate backtracking cost as (number of nodes) × (work per node), where nodes ≈ branching factor raised to the depth.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimate backtracking cost as (number of nodes) × (work per node), where nodes ≈ branching factor raised to the depth.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): lũy thừa (lên số mũ). "Raised to the power of k" = lũy thừa k; "raise an error" = ném lỗi.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to take to a power. "Raised to the power of k" means to the k-th power; "raise an error" means throw one.

items.question: Trong câu "or needs a valid configuration under constraints (Sudoku, word search on a grid, palindrome partitioning), backtracking is the natural fit.", từ "configuration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "or needs a valid configuration under constraints (Sudoku, word search on a grid, palindrome partitioning), backtracking is the natural fit.", what does "configuration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: configuration /kənˌfɪɡəˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): cách bố trí, sắp đặt. "A valid configuration" = một cách sắp đặt hợp lệ (ví dụ vị trí các quân hậu).
items.explanationEn: configuration /kənˌfɪɡəˈreɪʃn/ (noun): an arrangement of parts. A "valid configuration" is a legal arrangement, such as queen positions.

items.question: Trong câu "Because the output itself can be exponential, nothing does asymptotically better when you must list everything.", từ "asymptotically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because the output itself can be exponential, nothing does asymptotically better when you must list everything.", what does "asymptotically" (adverb) mean?
options: xét theo tiệm cận (n rất lớn)
items.explanation: asymptotically /ˌæsɪmpˈtɒtɪkli/ (trạng từ): xét theo tiệm cận (n rất lớn). "Asymptotically faster" = nhanh hơn khi n tiến tới rất lớn (theo Big-O).
items.explanationEn: asymptotically /ˌæsɪmpˈtɒtɪkli/ (adverb): as n grows very large. "Asymptotically faster" means faster as n grows large, in Big-O terms.

items.question: Trong câu "When the problem only asks for a count or the best value and subproblems repeat, switch to DP; when a provably safe local rule exists, switch to greedy.", từ "provably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the problem only asks for a count or the best value and subproblems repeat, switch to DP; when a provably safe local rule exists, switch to greedy.", what does "provably" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that can be proven
items.explanation: provably /ˈpruːvəbli/ (trạng từ): có thể chứng minh được. "Provably correct" = đúng và có chứng minh; đừng nhầm với "probably".
items.explanationEn: provably /ˈpruːvəbli/ (adverb): in a way that can be proven. "Provably correct" means correct with a proof; do not confuse it with "probably".

items.question: Trong câu "A greedy algorithm is correct only when the problem has two properties:", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A greedy algorithm is correct only when the problem has two properties:", what does "property" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (danh từ): tính chất, đặc tính. "Greedy-choice property" = tính chất lựa chọn tham lam; "property" còn là tài sản.
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒpəti/ (noun): a characteristic feature. The "greedy-choice property" is a characteristic; "property" also means possessions.

items.question: Trong câu "Greedy-choice property — some optimal solution starts with the greedy choice.", từ "optimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Greedy-choice property — some optimal solution starts with the greedy choice.", what does "optimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: optimal /ˈɒptɪməl/ (tính từ): tối ưu, tốt nhất. "Optimal solution" = lời giải tốt nhất; đừng nhầm với "optional" hay "optimistic".
items.explanationEn: optimal /ˈɒptɪməl/ (adjective): best possible. An "optimal solution" is the best one; do not confuse it with "optional" or "optimistic".

items.question: Trong câu "Taking it never rules out reaching the optimum.", từ "rule out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Taking it never rules out reaching the optimum.", what does "rule out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule out /ˌruːl ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): loại trừ khả năng. "Rule out X" = loại trừ khả năng X.
items.explanationEn: rule out /ˌruːl ˈaʊt/ (phrase): to make impossible. "Rule out X" means making X impossible or excluding it.

items.question: Trong câu "Optimal substructure — after making the choice, what remains is a smaller instance of the same problem, and an optimal solution to it combines with the choice into an optimal whole.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Optimal substructure — after making the choice, what remains is a smaller instance of the same problem, and an optimal solution to it combines with the choice into an optimal whole.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
options: trường hợp cụ thể (của bài toán)
optionsEn: a specific case of a problem
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (danh từ): trường hợp cụ thể (của bài toán). "A smaller instance of the problem" = một trường hợp nhỏ hơn của cùng bài toán.
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (noun): a specific case of a problem. "A smaller instance of the problem" is a smaller case of the same problem.

items.question: Trong câu "DP needs optimal substructure too; greedy additionally needs property 1, which lets it skip trying the alternatives.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DP needs optimal substructure too; greedy additionally needs property 1, which lets it skip trying the alternatives.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ (danh từ): phương án thay thế. "Skip the alternatives" = không cần thử các phương án khác.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ (noun): another possible option. "Skip the alternatives" means not trying the other possible options.

items.question: Trong câu "To justify greedy in an interview, use an exchange argument: take any optimal solution that differs from the greedy one, swap in the greedy choice, and show the result is no worse.", từ "justify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To justify greedy in an interview, use an exchange argument: take any optimal solution that differs from the greedy one, swap in the greedy choice, and show the result is no worse.", what does "justify" (verb) mean?
options: biện minh, chứng minh là đúng
items.explanation: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (động từ): biện minh, chứng minh là đúng. "Justify a choice" = đưa lý lẽ chứng minh lựa chọn đúng; "justify text" là căn đều.
items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (verb): to show to be right. "Justify a choice" means giving reasons it is right; "justify text" means aligning it.

items.question: Trong câu "To justify greedy in an interview, use an exchange argument: take any optimal solution that differs from the greedy one, swap in the greedy choice, and show the result is no worse.", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To justify greedy in an interview, use an exchange argument: take any optimal solution that differs from the greedy one, swap in the greedy choice, and show the result is no worse.", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (danh từ): lập luận. "Exchange argument" = lập luận hoán đổi; trong code "argument" là đối số truyền vào hàm.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (noun): a line of reasoning. An "exchange argument" is a line of reasoning; in code an argument is a value passed in.

items.question: Trong câu "To justify greedy in an interview, use an exchange argument: take any optimal solution that differs from the greedy one, swap in the greedy choice, and show the result is no worse.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To justify greedy in an interview, use an exchange argument: take any optimal solution that differs from the greedy one, swap in the greedy choice, and show the result is no worse.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪfər/ (động từ): khác với. "Differ from X" = khác với X; danh từ "difference".
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪfər/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ from X" means being unlike X; the noun is "difference".

items.question: Trong câu "Before that, hunt for a counterexample with small inputs and ties — one is enough to kill a greedy rule.", từ "counterexample" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before that, hunt for a counterexample with small inputs and ties — one is enough to kill a greedy rule.", what does "counterexample" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: counterexample /ˈkaʊntərɪɡˌzɑːmpl/ (danh từ): phản ví dụ. "Find a counterexample" = tìm một ví dụ cho thấy quy tắc sai.
items.explanationEn: counterexample /ˈkaʊntərɪɡˌzɑːmpl/ (noun): an example that disproves. "Find a counterexample" means finding one case that proves a rule wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "Before that, hunt for a counterexample with small inputs and ties — one is enough to kill a greedy rule.", từ "tie" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before that, hunt for a counterexample with small inputs and ties — one is enough to kill a greedy rule.", what does "tie" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tie /taɪ/ (danh từ): trường hợp bằng nhau. "Ties" = các giá trị bằng nhau; "break ties" = phân xử khi bằng nhau.
items.explanationEn: tie /taɪ/ (noun): a case of equal values. "Ties" are equal values; "break ties" means deciding between them.

items.question: Trong câu "Problem: given meetings [start, end], choose the maximum number that do not overlap (one that starts exactly when another ends is fine).", từ "overlap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Problem: given meetings [start, end], choose the maximum number that do not overlap (one that starts exactly when another ends is fine).", what does "overlap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cover part of the same span
items.explanation: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (động từ): chồng lên nhau, giao nhau. "Intervals overlap" = các khoảng thời gian giao nhau.
items.explanationEn: overlap /ˌəʊvəˈlæp/ (verb): to cover part of the same span. "Intervals overlap" when they share part of the same time span.

items.question: Trong câu "Greedy rule: sort by end time, and take each meeting that starts no earlier than the last chosen one ends.", từ "no earlier than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Greedy rule: sort by end time, and take each meeting that starts no earlier than the last chosen one ends.", what does "no earlier than" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: at the same time or later
items.explanation: no earlier than /nəʊ ˈɜːliə ðæn/ (cụm từ): không sớm hơn (bằng hoặc sau). "No earlier than X" = từ X trở đi; "no later than X" = chậm nhất là X.
items.explanationEn: no earlier than /nəʊ ˈɜːliə ðæn/ (phrase): at the same time or later. "No earlier than X" means at X or after; "no later than X" means by X at the latest.

items.question: Trong câu "G ends no later than X, so it cannot collide with anything that came after X — the schedule is still valid and just as large.", từ "collide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "G ends no later than X, so it cannot collide with anything that came after X — the schedule is still valid and just as large.", what does "collide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (động từ): xung đột, trùng nhau. "Collide with" = xung đột với; "hash collision" = va chạm băm.
items.explanationEn: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (verb): to conflict, overlap. "Collide with" means conflict with; compare "hash collision".

items.question: Trong câu "Track the farthest reachable index.", từ "reachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Track the farthest reachable index.", what does "reachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (tính từ): có thể tới được. "Reachable index" = chỉ số có thể nhảy tới; "unreachable code" = code không bao giờ chạy.
items.explanationEn: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (adjective): able to be got to. A "reachable index" can be jumped to; "unreachable code" never runs.

items.question: Trong câu "The recurring shape is sort (or use a heap), then make one pass.", từ "recurring" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recurring shape is sort (or use a heap), then make one pass.", what does "recurring" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recurring /rɪˈkɜːrɪŋ/ (tính từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Recurring pattern" = khuôn mẫu lặp lại nhiều lần; khác "recursive" (đệ quy).
items.explanationEn: recurring /rɪˈkɜːrɪŋ/ (adjective): happening again and again. A "recurring pattern" keeps coming back; it differs from "recursive".

items.question: Trong câu "Other provably optimal greedy algorithms: fractional knapsack (highest value/weight ratio first), Kruskal's MST (cheapest edge that makes no cycle) and Dijkstra (settle the closest vertex).", từ "settle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other provably optimal greedy algorithms: fractional knapsack (highest value/weight ratio first), Kruskal's MST (cheapest edge that makes no cycle) and Dijkstra (settle the closest vertex).", what does "settle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: settle /ˈsetl/ (động từ): chốt, xác định dứt khoát. Trong Dijkstra, "settle a vertex" = chốt khoảng cách ngắn nhất của đỉnh đó.
items.explanationEn: settle /ˈsetl/ (verb): to fix as final. In Dijkstra, "settle a vertex" means fixing its shortest distance for good.

items.question: Trong câu "Other provably optimal greedy algorithms: fractional knapsack (highest value/weight ratio first), Kruskal's MST (cheapest edge that makes no cycle) and Dijkstra (settle the closest vertex).", từ "fractional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other provably optimal greedy algorithms: fractional knapsack (highest value/weight ratio first), Kruskal's MST (cheapest edge that makes no cycle) and Dijkstra (settle the closest vertex).", what does "fractional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fractional /ˈfrækʃənl/ (tính từ): lấy được một phần (phân số). "Fractional knapsack" = được lấy một phần vật; "a fractional increase" = tăng rất ít.
items.explanationEn: fractional /ˈfrækʃənl/ (adjective): allowing parts of a whole. "Fractional knapsack" allows taking parts of items; "a fractional increase" is tiny.

items.question: Trong câu "sort coins descending and keep taking the largest one that fits", từ "descending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sort coins descending and keep taking the largest one that fits", what does "descending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: descending /dɪˈsendɪŋ/ (tính từ): giảm dần. "Sort descending" = sắp xếp giảm dần; trái nghĩa "ascending".
items.explanationEn: descending /dɪˈsendɪŋ/ (adjective): from largest to smallest. "Sort descending" goes from largest to smallest; the opposite is "ascending".

items.question: Trong câu "Change the denominations and it breaks:", từ "denomination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change the denominations and it breaks:", what does "denomination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: denomination /dɪˌnɒmɪˈneɪʃn/ (danh từ): mệnh giá (tiền). "Coin denominations" = các mệnh giá đồng xu; nghĩa khác là giáo phái.
items.explanationEn: denomination /dɪˌnɒmɪˈneɪʃn/ (noun): a face value of money. "Coin denominations" are face values; the word also means a religious group.

items.question: Trong câu "Taking 4 first looked best, but it left a remainder (2) that only small coins can fill.", từ "remainder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Taking 4 first looked best, but it left a remainder (2) that only small coins can fill.", what does "remainder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: remainder /rɪˈmeɪndər/ (danh từ): phần còn lại. "Remainder" = phần còn lại; trong phép chia là số dư; đừng nhầm "reminder".
items.explanationEn: remainder /rɪˈmeɪndər/ (noun): the amount left over. "Remainder" is what is left over; in division it is the modulo result; not "reminder".

items.question: Trong câu "The greedy-choice property does not hold for arbitrary denominations.", từ "arbitrary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The greedy-choice property does not hold for arbitrary denominations.", what does "arbitrary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: arbitrary /ˈɑːbɪtrəri/ (tính từ): tùy ý, bất kỳ. "Arbitrary input" = đầu vào bất kỳ; "arbitrary decision" = quyết định tùy tiện.
items.explanationEn: arbitrary /ˈɑːbɪtrəri/ (adjective): any, freely chosen. "Arbitrary input" means any input; an "arbitrary decision" is an unreasoned one.

items.question: Trong câu "It happens to hold for "canonical" systems such as US coins, which is why the rule feels right.", từ "happen to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It happens to hold for "canonical" systems such as US coins, which is why the rule feels right.", what does "happen to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: happen to /ˈhæpən tə/ (cụm từ): tình cờ, ngẫu nhiên mà. "Happen to do" = tình cờ mà; "what happened to him" = chuyện gì xảy ra với anh ấy.
items.explanationEn: happen to /ˈhæpən tə/ (phrase): by chance, coincidentally. "Happen to do" means by chance; "what happened to him" asks what occurred.

items.question: Trong câu "It can even fail to find any answer: with {3, 5} and 9, greedy takes 5 and gets stuck at 4, yet 3 + 3 + 3 works.", từ "get stuck" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It can even fail to find any answer: with {3, 5} and 9, greedy takes 5 and gets stuck at 4, yet 3 + 3 + 3 works.", what does "get stuck" (phrase) mean?
options: bị kẹt, không đi tiếp được
items.explanation: get stuck /ɡet ˈstʌk/ (cụm từ): bị kẹt, không đi tiếp được. "Get stuck at 4" = bị kẹt ở 4, không còn cách đi tiếp.
items.explanationEn: get stuck /ɡet ˈstʌk/ (phrase): to be unable to continue. "Get stuck at 4" means being unable to make further progress from 4.

items.question: Trong câu "The fix is DP (topic 20): dp[a] = min over coins c ≤ a of dp[a − c] + 1, which considers every coin for every sub-amount in O(amount · k) time for k coin types and O(amount) space.", từ "fix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The fix is DP (topic 20): dp[a] = min over coins c ≤ a of dp[a − c] + 1, which considers every coin for every sub-amount in O(amount · k) time for k coin types and O(amount) space.", what does "fix" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fix /fɪks/ (danh từ): cách khắc phục. "The fix is X" = cách sửa là X; "be in a fix" = đang gặp khó.
items.explanationEn: fix /fɪks/ (noun): a solution to a problem. "The fix is X" means X solves it; "be in a fix" means being in trouble.

items.question: Trong câu "The same trap appears in 0/1 knapsack: greedy by value/weight ratio is optimal for the fractional version but not when items cannot be split.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same trap appears in 0/1 knapsack: greedy by value/weight ratio is optimal for the fractional version but not when items cannot be split.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
options: cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc
optionsEn: an easy mistake to fall into
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc. "Fall into a trap" = mắc bẫy; "common trap" = lỗi hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): an easy mistake to fall into. "Fall into a trap" means making an easy mistake; "common trap" is a frequent one.

items.question: Trong câu "The same trap appears in 0/1 knapsack: greedy by value/weight ratio is optimal for the fractional version but not when items cannot be split.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same trap appears in 0/1 knapsack: greedy by value/weight ratio is optimal for the fractional version but not when items cannot be split.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia nhỏ, tách ra. "Items cannot be split" = vật không thể chia nhỏ; "split up" còn là chia tay.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Items cannot be split" means they cannot be divided; "split up" can mean break up.

items.question: Trong câu "Capacity 50, items (weight 10, value 60), (20, 100), (30, 120): ratio-greedy takes the first two for value 160, but the optimum is the last two for 220.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Capacity 50, items (weight 10, value 60), (20, 100), (30, 120): ratio-greedy takes the first two for value 160, but the optimum is the last two for 220.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (danh từ): sức chứa tối đa. "Knapsack capacity" = sức chứa của túi; "in my capacity as" = với tư cách là.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (noun): the maximum amount held. "Knapsack capacity" is how much it holds; "in my capacity as" means in my role as.

items.question: Trong câu "Capacity 50, items (weight 10, value 60), (20, 100), (30, 120): ratio-greedy takes the first two for value 160, but the optimum is the last two for 220.", từ "optimum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Capacity 50, items (weight 10, value 60), (20, 100), (30, 120): ratio-greedy takes the first two for value 160, but the optimum is the last two for 220.", what does "optimum" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: optimum /ˈɒptɪməm/ (danh từ): giá trị/phương án tối ưu. "The optimum" (danh từ) = phương án tốt nhất; tính từ tương ứng là "optimal".
items.explanationEn: optimum /ˈɒptɪməm/ (noun): the best possible result. "The optimum" (noun) is the best result; the related adjective is "optimal".

items.question: Trong câu "A practical decision flow:", từ "practical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practical decision flow:", what does "practical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: practical /ˈpræktɪkl/ (tính từ): thực dụng, áp dụng được. "Practical advice" = lời khuyên áp dụng được ngay; trái nghĩa "theoretical".
items.explanationEn: practical /ˈpræktɪkl/ (adjective): useful in real situations. "Practical advice" is usable in real life; the opposite is "theoretical".

items.question: Trong câu "Pruning (sort + break, N-Queens sets for columns, row − col, row + col) separates backtracking from brute force.", từ "separate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pruning (sort + break, N-Queens sets for columns, row − col, row + col) separates backtracking from brute force.", what does "separate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (động từ): phân biệt, tách biệt. "Separate A from B" = tách A khỏi B, làm A khác B; tính từ đọc /ˈseprət/.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (verb): to set apart, distinguish. "Separate A from B" means distinguishing them; the adjective is /ˈseprət/.

items.question: Trong câu "Subsets (2ⁿ), permutations (n!), combination sum and N-Queens are the core patterns; pruning shrinks the explored tree.", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Subsets (2ⁿ), permutations (n!), combination sum and N-Queens are the core patterns; pruning shrinks the explored tree.", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): làm thu nhỏ. "Shrink the search space" = thu nhỏ không gian tìm kiếm.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to make smaller. "Shrink the search space" means making it smaller.

items.question: Trong câu "Subsets (2ⁿ), permutations (n!), combination sum and N-Queens are the core patterns; pruning shrinks the explored tree.", từ "core" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Subsets (2ⁿ), permutations (n!), combination sum and N-Queens are the core patterns; pruning shrinks the explored tree.", what does "core" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: core /kɔːr/ (tính từ): cốt lõi, chủ chốt. "Core patterns" = các khuôn mẫu cốt lõi; danh từ "core" còn là lõi CPU.
items.explanationEn: core /kɔːr/ (adjective): central, most important. "Core patterns" are the central ones; as a noun "core" also means a CPU core.

items.question: Trong câu "Greedy makes one irrevocable locally best choice per step: fast (typically sort + one pass), but it needs a proof.", từ "irrevocable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Greedy makes one irrevocable locally best choice per step: fast (typically sort + one pass), but it needs a proof.", what does "irrevocable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: irrevocable /ɪˈrevəkəbl/ (tính từ): không thể đảo ngược. "Irrevocable choice" = lựa chọn không thể rút lại; gốc từ "revoke" (thu hồi).
items.explanationEn: irrevocable /ɪˈrevəkəbl/ (adjective): impossible to undo. An "irrevocable choice" cannot be taken back; it comes from "revoke".

items.question: Trong câu "Backtracking explores the state-space tree depth-first, abandoning invalid partial answers: always correct, usually exponential.", từ "invalid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backtracking explores the state-space tree depth-first, abandoning invalid partial answers: always correct, usually exponential.", what does "invalid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invalid /ɪnˈvælɪd/ (tính từ): không hợp lệ. "Invalid" /ɪnˈvælɪd/ = không hợp lệ; danh từ "invalid" /ˈɪnvəlɪd/ là người ốm yếu.
items.explanationEn: invalid /ɪnˈvælɪd/ (adjective): not allowed by the rules. "Invalid" /ɪnˈvælɪd/ means not valid; the noun /ˈɪnvəlɪd/ means a sick person.
